title: Defense bases deliberately placed at natural portal sites like Area 51
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Defense bases deliberately placed at natural portal sites like Area 51, about 1950s onward at Nevada test site and Area 51, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Area 51 / Nevada Test Site / Skinwalker Ranch

tellings.quote: floors. Do you think that some of these defense bases are colllocated deliberately with, and this is going to sound really trippy, but like natural portals or something?

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, puts a question to a guest that he admits sounds trippy: could some American military bases have been built on purpose at natural "portals", places where something from elsewhere might come through? He has in mind sites set up from the 1950s on, like Area 51, a secret Air Force test site in the Nevada desert, the nearby Nevada Test Site where nuclear weapons were tested, and Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for strange reports. If he were right, the military would have known about such places and quietly chosen to sit right on top of them.
